name: VESA adapters (set of 4)
note: Bolt each screen's VESA holes to its aluminium beam. Two are flat plates, two are tall, because the side beams sit one beam higher.

note: One USB camera behind each side window, so she knows which side you are on and that view is drawn from where you stand.

name: Crown exhaust grille

name: Electronics trays (pair)
note: Hang under the cross rails and carry the ESP32, amplifier, USB hub and power board.

name: Aluminium 3030 frame (posts, rings, beams)
note: Four 1.235 m corner posts, three square rings, two cross rails under the deck and four beams that carry the screens. Cut to length by the supplier.
